# 12-Week Plant-Based Muscle Gain Programme

## Client Profile Summary
- **Age/Sex:** 26F
- **Experience:** Recreational lifter (intermediate)
- **Goal:** Muscle hypertrophy
- **Dietary:** Strict vegan, 150g protein/day from plant sources
- **Equipment:** Full gym access

---

## NUTRITION FOUNDATION

### Daily Macronutrient Targets
- **Protein:** 150g (2.2g per kg assumed ~68kg bodyweight)
- **Calories:** Maintenance + 300–500 surplus (adjust based on progress)
- **Carbs:** 200–250g (fuel for training and recovery)
- **Fats:** 50–70g (hormone health, satiety)

### Plant Protein Sources (150g daily strategy)

**Whole Foods (primary):**
- Tofu/tempeh: 15–20g per 100g
- Lentils (cooked): 9g per 100g
- Chickpeas (cooked): 8g per 100g
- Hemp seeds: 10g per 3 tbsp
- Pumpkin seeds: 9g per 1/4 cup
- Nutritional yeast: 8g per 2 tbsp
- Quinoa (cooked): 8g per cup
- Whole grain bread: 4–5g per slice

**Supplementation (recommended):**
- Vegan protein powder (pea/rice/hemp blend): 20–25g per serving
- Creatine monohydrate: 5g daily (vegan-friendly, supports muscle gains)
- Algae-based omega-3 (EPA/DHA): daily
- Vitamin B12: 2000 IU weekly or 25–100 mcg daily
- Vitamin D3 (vegan): 2000–4000 IU daily
- Iron: monitor levels; consider supplementation if needed

### Sample Daily Eating Pattern

**Breakfast (35g protein)**
- Oatmeal (50g) with plant milk
- Hemp seeds (3 tbsp)
- Vegan protein powder (1 scoop, 25g)
- Banana, berries

**Mid-Morning Snack (15g protein)**
- Hummus (3 tbsp) + whole grain crackers + carrot sticks

**Lunch (40g protein)**
- Tofu stir-fry (150g tofu, 20g) with quinoa (1 cup cooked, 8g)
- Broccoli, sesame seeds (3 tbsp, 5g)
- Olive oil

**Pre-Workout (15g protein, 30–45 min before)**
- Banana + almond butter (2 tbsp, 7g) + vegan protein shake (8g)

**Post-Workout (25g protein, within 60 min)**
- Vegan protein shake (25g) + white rice cakes + dates

**Dinner (40g protein)**
- Lentil bolognese (150g cooked lentils, 13g) with whole wheat pasta
- Nutritional yeast (2 tbsp, 8g)
- Tempeh bacon (100g, 19g)
- Salad with pumpkin seeds

**Evening Snack (optional, 10g protein)**
- Soy yogurt (150g, 10g) + granola

---

## TRAINING PROGRAMME OVERVIEW

**Structure:** 4-day upper/lower split  
**Duration:** 12 weeks (3 phases of 4 weeks)  
**Rep Ranges:** Hypertrophy-focused (8–12 reps primary, 6–8 and 12–15 secondary)  
**Rest Days:** 3 per week (minimum 48 hours between same muscle groups)  
**Progressive Overload:** +2–5% weight or +1–2 reps per week

---

## PHASE 1: FOUNDATION & ADAPTATION (Weeks 1–4)

**Focus:** Movement quality, work capacity, baseline strength, metabolic adaptation to surplus

### Week 1–4 Structure
- **Monday:** Upper Power
- **Tuesday:** Lower Power
- **Thursday:** Upper Hypertrophy
- **Friday:** Lower Hypertrophy

---

### MONDAY: Upper Power (Weeks 1–4)

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Rest | Notes |
|----------|------|------|------|-------|
| Barbell Bench Press | 4 | 6–8 | 3 min | Main lift; focus on form |
| Bent-Over Barbell Row | 4 | 6–8 | 3 min | Chest-supported if needed |
| Incline Dumbbell Press | 3 | 8–10 | 2 min | Secondary pressing |
| Seal Rows or Machine Row | 3 | 8–10 | 2 min | Isolation row |
| Dumbbell Lateral Raise | 3 | 10–12 | 90 sec | Shoulder health |
| Barbell Curl | 3 | 8–10 | 90 sec | Arm work |
| Tricep Rope Pushdown | 3 | 10–12 | 60 sec | Arm finisher |

**Duration:** ~60 minutes  
**RPE:** 7–8/10 (challenging but controlled)

---

### TUESDAY: Lower Power (Weeks 1–4)

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Rest | Notes |
|----------|------|------|------|-------|
| Barbell Back Squat | 4 | 6–8 | 3 min | Main lift |
| Barbell Deadlift (or Trap Bar) | 3 | 5–6 | 3 min | Secondary strength |
| Bulgarian Split Squat | 3 | 8–10 ea | 2 min | Unilateral work |
| Leg Curl Machine | 3 | 10–12 | 90 sec | Hamstring isolation |
| Leg Extension | 3 | 10–12 | 90 sec | Quad isolation |
| Calf Raise (machine or barbell) | 3 | 12–15 | 60 sec | Calf work |

**Duration:** ~55 minutes  
**RPE:** 7–8/10

---

### THURSDAY: Upper Hypertrophy (Weeks 1–4)

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Rest | Notes |
|----------|------|------|------|-------|
| Incline Barbell Bench | 4 | 8–10 | 2 min | Upper chest emphasis |
| Chest-Supported Row | 4 | 8–10 | 2 min | Chest-supported variation |
| Dumbbell Flye | 3 | 10–12 | 90 sec | Chest stretch/squeeze |
| Lat Pulldown | 3 | 10–12 | 90 sec | Back width |
| Machine Chest Press | 3 | 10–12 | 90 sec | Chest finisher |
| Face Pulls | 3 | 12–15 | 60 sec | Rear delt/shoulder health |
| Dumbbell Hammer Curl | 3 | 10–12 | 60 sec | Arm hypertrophy |

**Duration:** ~55 minutes  
**RPE:** 6–7/10 (moderate intensity, higher volume)

---

### FRIDAY: Lower Hypertrophy (Weeks 1–4)

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Rest | Notes |
|----------|------|------|------|-------|
| Leg Press | 4 | 8–10 | 2 min | Main lower hypertrophy |
| Romanian Deadlift | 3 | 8–10 | 2 min | Posterior chain |
| Leg Extension | 4 | 10–12 | 90 sec | Quad isolation |
| Lying Leg Curl | 4 | 10–12 | 90 sec | Hamstring isolation |
| Hack Squat or V-Squat | 3 | 10–12 | 90 sec | Quad finisher |
| Seated Calf Raise | 3 | 12–15 | 60 sec | Calf isolation |

**Duration:** ~55 minutes  
**RPE:** 6–7/10

---

## PHASE 2: HYPERTROPHY EMPHASIS (Weeks 5–8)

**Focus:** Increased volume, moderate intensity, muscle damage and metabolic stress

### Week 5–8 Structure
- **Monday:** Upper Hypertrophy A
- **Tuesday:** Lower Hypertrophy A
- **Thursday:** Upper Hypertrophy B
- **Friday:** Lower Hypertrophy B

---

### MONDAY: Upper Hypertrophy A (Weeks 5–8)

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Rest | Notes |
|----------|------|------|------|-------|
| Dumbbell Bench Press | 4 | 8–10 | 2 min | Main pressing |
| Barbell Bent-Over Row | 4 | 8–10 | 2 min | Main pulling |
| Machine Chest Press | 3 | 10–12 | 90 sec | Chest volume |
| Seal Rows | 3 | 10–12 | 90 sec | Back volume |
| Dumbbell Lateral Raise | 3 | 12–15 | 75 sec | Shoulder isolation |
| Dumbbell Curl | 3 | 10–12 | 75 sec | Bicep hypertrophy |
| Overhead Tricep Extension | 3 | 10–12 | 75 sec | Tricep hypertrophy |
| Machine Pec Deck | 2 | 12–15 | 60 sec | Chest finisher |

**Duration:** ~65 minutes  
**RPE:** 6–7/10

---

### TUESDAY: Lower Hypertrophy A (Weeks 5–8)

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Rest | Notes |
|----------|------|------|------|-------|
| Barbell Back Squat | 4 | 8–10 | 2 min | Main lower |
| Leg Press | 3 | 10–12 | 2 min | Secondary quad |
| Bulgarian Split Squat | 3 | 10–12 ea | 90 sec | Unilateral quad |
| Lying Leg Curl | 4 | 10–12 | 90 sec | Hamstring volume |
| Leg Extension | 3 | 12–15 | 75 sec | Quad finisher |
| Calf Raise (machine) | 3 | 12–15 | 60 sec | Calf work |

**Duration:** ~60 minutes  
**RPE:** 6–7/10

---

### THURSDAY: Upper Hypertrophy B (Weeks 5–8)

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Rest | Notes |
|----------|------|------|------|-------|
| Incline Barbell Bench | 4 | 8–10 | 2 min | Upper chest |
| Chest-Supported Row | 4 | 8–10 | 2 min | Back thickness |
| Dumbbell Flye | 3 | 10–12 | 90 sec | Chest stretch |
| Lat Pulldown | 3 | 10–12 | 90 sec | Back width |
| Machine Shoulder Press | 3 | 10–12 | 90 sec | Shoulder hypertrophy |
| Face Pulls | 3 | 12–15 | 75 sec | Rear delt/health |
| Barbell Curl | 3 | 8–10 | 75 sec | Bicep strength-hypertrophy |
| Rope Pushdown | 3 | 12–15 | 60 sec | Tricep finisher |

**Duration:** ~65 minutes  
**RPE:** 6–7/10

---

### FRIDAY: Lower Hypertrophy B (Weeks 5–8)

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Rest | Notes |
|----------|------|------|------|-------|
| Leg Press | 4 | 8–10 | 2 min | Main lower |
| Romanian Deadlift | 3 | 8–10 | 2 min | Posterior chain |
| Hack Squat | 3 | 10–12 | 90 sec | Quad isolation |
| Leg Curl Machine | 4 | 10–12 | 90 sec | Hamstring volume |
| Leg Extension | 3 | 12–15 | 75 sec | Quad finisher |
| Seated Calf Raise | 3 | 12–15 | 60 sec | Calf isolation |

**Duration:** ~60 minutes  
**RPE:** 6–7/10

---

## PHASE 3: STRENGTH-HYPERTROPHY BLEND (Weeks 9–12)

**Focus:** Consolidate gains, increase intensity, maintain volume, peak strength

### Week 9–12 Structure
- **Monday:** Upper Strength-Hypertrophy
- **Tuesday:** Lower Strength-Hypertrophy
- **Thursday:** Upper Hypertrophy-Endurance
- **Friday:** Lower Hypertrophy-Endurance

---

### MONDAY: Upper Strength-Hypertrophy (Weeks 9–12)

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Rest | Notes |
|----------|------|------|------|-------|
| Barbell Bench Press | 5 | 5–6 | 3 min | Strength focus; increase load |
| Bent-Over Barbell Row | 5 | 5–6 | 3 min | Strength focus |
| Incline Dumbbell Press | 3 | 8–10 | 2 min | Hypertrophy secondary |
| Seal Rows | 3 | 8–10 | 2 min | Hypertrophy secondary |
| Dumbbell Lateral Raise | 3 | 10–12 | 90 sec | Shoulder isolation |
| Barbell Curl | 3 | 6–8 | 90 sec | Strength-hypertrophy |
| Tricep Rope Pushdown | 3 | 10–12 | 75 sec | Hypertrophy finisher |
| Machine Pec Deck | 2 | 12–15 | 60 sec | Chest finisher |

**Duration:** ~65 minutes  
**RPE:** 7–8/10

---

### TUESDAY: Lower Strength-Hypertrophy (Weeks 9–12)

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Rest | Notes |
|----------|------|------|------|-------|
| Barbell Back Squat | 5 | 5–6 | 3 min | Strength focus; increase load |
| Barbell Deadlift | 3 | 3–5 | 3 min | Strength secondary |
| Bulgarian Split Squat | 3 | 8–10 ea | 2 min | Unilateral hypertrophy |
| Lying Leg Curl | 3 | 8–10 | 2 min | Hamstring hypertrophy |
| Leg Extension | 3 | 10–12 | 90 sec | Quad isolation |
| Calf Raise (machine) | 3 | 12–15 | 60 sec | Calf work |

**Duration:** ~60 minutes  
**RPE:** 7–8/10

---

### THURSDAY: Upper Hypertrophy-Endurance (Weeks 9–12)

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Rest | Notes |
|----------|------|------|------|-------|
| Incline Barbell Bench | 4 | 8–10 | 2 min | Upper chest |
| Chest-Supported Row | 4 | 8–10 | 2 min | Back thickness |
| Dumbbell Flye | 3 | 10–12 | 90 sec | Chest stretch |
| Lat Pulldown | 3 | 10–12 | 90 sec | Back width |
| Machine Shoulder Press | 3 | 10–12 | 90 sec | Shoulder hypertrophy |
| Face Pulls | 3 | 15–20 | 75 sec | Rear delt/endurance |
| Dumbbell Hammer Curl | 3 | 10–12 | 75 sec | Bicep hypertrophy |
| Overhead Tricep Extension | 3 | 12–15 | 60 sec | Tricep hypertrophy |

**Duration:** ~65 minutes  
**RPE:** 6–7/10

---

### FRIDAY: Lower Hypertrophy-Endurance (Weeks 9–12)

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Rest | Notes |
|----------|------|------|------|-------|
| Leg Press | 4 | 8–10 | 2 min | Main lower |
| Romanian Deadlift | 3 | 8–10 | 2 min | Posterior chain |
| Hack Squat | 3 | 10–12 | 90 sec | Quad isolation |
| Leg Curl Machine | 3 | 10–12 | 90 sec | Hamstring hypertrophy |
| Leg Extension | 3 | 12–15 | 90 sec | Quad finisher |
| Seated Calf Raise | 3 | 15–20 | 60 sec | Calf endurance |

**Duration:** ~60 minutes  
**RPE:** 6–7/10

---

## PROGRESSIVE OVERLOAD STRATEGY

**Week-to-Week Progression:**

- **Weeks 1–4:** Establish baseline; add 1–2 reps per week or 2–3% weight increase
- **Weeks 5–8:** Increase volume; add 1 set to 2–3 exercises per week, or 2–5% weight increase
- **Weeks 9–12:** Increase intensity; prioritize 3–5% weight increases on main lifts; maintain or slightly reduce volume

**Tracking:** Use a simple spreadsheet or app (e.g., Strong, JEFIT) to log all sets, reps, and weights. Review weekly and adjust based on RPE and form quality.

---

## RECOVERY & LIFESTYLE

### Sleep
- **Target:** 7–9 hours nightly
- **Rationale:** Critical for muscle protein synthesis and hormonal balance on a plant-based diet

### Stress Management
- 5–10 min daily meditation or breathing work
- Manage training stress with adequate rest days

### Hydration
- **Minimum:** 3–4 liters daily; more on training days
- **Electrolytes:** Consider a vegan electrolyte supplement on intense training days

### Deload Week (Optional)
- **Week 13 (post-programme):** Reduce volume by 40–50%, maintain intensity; allows CNS recovery and tissue repair

---

## SUPPLEMENTATION SUMMARY

| Supplement | Dose | Timing | Rationale |
|------------|------|--------|-----------|
| Vegan Protein Powder | 25–50g/day | Post-workout + meals | Protein target |
| Creatine Monohydrate | 5g/day | Anytime | Muscle strength/size |
| Algae Omega-3 (EPA/DHA) | 200–300mg EPA+DHA | With meal | Inflammation, brain health |
| Vitamin B12 | 2000 IU weekly or 25–100 mcg daily | Daily or weekly | Energy, neurological health |
| Vitamin D3 (vegan) | 2000–4000 IU | Daily | Bone health, immunity |
| Iron (if needed) | 18–27mg | With vitamin C | Energy, oxygen transport |
| Iodine (if needed) | 150 mcg | Daily | Thyroid function |

**Note:** Recommend bloodwork at baseline and week 12 to assess B12, iron, vitamin D, and omega-3 status.

---

## WEEKLY CHECKLIST

- [ ] Log all workouts (weight, reps, RPE)
- [ ] Hit 150g protein daily
- [ ] Sleep 7–9 hours
- [ ] Drink 3–4L water
- [ ] Take supplements consistently
- [ ] Assess soreness and fatigue (adjust if needed)
- [ ] Weekly weigh-in (same time, same conditions)
- [ ] Progress photos (every 2 weeks)

---

## EXPECTED OUTCOMES (12 weeks)

- **Muscle Gain:** 2–4 kg (assuming proper adherence to nutrition and training)
- **Strength Gains:** 10–20% increase on main lifts (squat, bench, deadlift, row)
- **Body Composition:** Improved muscle definition, reduced body fat (if calorie surplus is modest)
- **Work Capacity:** Increased ability to handle volume and intensity

---

## NOTES FOR TRAINER

1. **Protein Timing:** While total daily protein matters most, distribute across 4–5 meals for optimal MPS (muscle protein synthesis).
2. **Vegan Protein Quality:** Combine incomplete proteins (e.g., rice + beans) or use complete plant proteins (soy, hemp, quinoa) to ensure all amino acids.
3. **Calorie Surplus:** Start at +300 kcal; if weight gain stalls after 3 weeks, increase to +400–500 kcal.
4. **Monitoring:** Check in weekly on energy, soreness, and mood. Adjust nutrition if fatigue is high.
5. **Bioavailability:** Plant-based iron and calcium have lower bioavailability; consider supplementation and pair with vitamin C for iron absorption.
6. **Sustainability:** Ensure the client enjoys the food and training. Flexibility in meal timing and exercise selection improves adherence.

---

This programme balances hypertrophy, strength, and metabolic stress while meeting the nutritional demands of plant-based muscle building. Adjust based on individual response and feedback.
